segments.he: בְּיוֹם שֵׁנִי הָיִיתִי אֲנִי לְבַדִּי בְּלא חֲבֵרִי רַבִּי יְהוּדָא אֱלִיעֶזֶר עַל קֶבֶר הַתַּנָּא רַבִּי חֻצְפִּית הַמְתֻרְגְּמָן, אֶחָד מֵעֲשָׂרָה הֲרוּגֵי מַלְכוּת, וְעַל קֶבֶר יְהוֹיָדָע הַכּהֵן הַמֻּנָּח סָמוּךְ לְשָׁם:
segments.en: And behold — on Friday I arose early. And I was then very pressed. For I had still not seen the captain — and had not hired the ship. And had still not received the Tiskire. And had also not yet received the money from the rav. And today was Erev Shabbas Kodesh. And today we needed to board the ship and buy what was needed.
